description: Representative IPs for the SSRF public-address rule. blocked must not be fetched: CPython is_global is false, plus the extra ranges the engine rejects in apps/engine/app/utils/ssrf.py (192.88.99.0/24, 100:0:0:1::/64, 5f00::/16, and 64:ff9b::/96 when the embedded IPv4 is not public). allowed is safe to fetch, including 192.0.0.9 and 192.0.0.10 (global anycast) and 64:ff9b::8.8.8.8. blockedBeyondPython lists multicast addresses Python reports as global but the web deliberately still blocks (stricter than the engine; never looser). The engine sync test reads this file. The web and MCP isPublicIp copies learn the new blocked rows on the sibling web branch; until that lands, their sync tests fail these rows. Consumed by apps/web/lib/generation/__tests__/public-ip-ssrf-sync.test.ts and apps/mcp/src/__tests__/clone-audio-ssrf.test.ts. The blocked/allowed lists include every literal representative asserted in apps/engine/test/utils/test_ssrf.py.
